kept.q: A block of wood has a mass of 450 g and a volume of 500 cm^3. What is the density of the wood in kg/m^3?
kept.explanation: Density = mass/volume = 450 g / 500 cm^3 = 0.9 g/cm^3. Converting to kg/m^3, multiply by 1000, giving 900 kg/m^3.
kept.pidgin: Density na mass divide by volume = 450g/500cm^3 = 0.9 g/cm^3. If you change am to kg/m^3, you go multiply by 1000, e go be 900 kg/m^3.

kept.q: A tank in Mrs. Okafor's shop contains water (density 1000 kg/m^3) up to a depth of 2.5 m. Taking g = 10 m/s^2, calculate the pressure exerted by the water at the bottom of the tank.
kept.explanation: Pressure in a liquid is P = h x density x g = 2.5 x 1000 x 10 = 25000 N/m^2. This is the correct application of the liquid pressure formula.
kept.pidgin: Pressure for liquid na P = h x density x g = 2.5 x 1000 x 10 = 25000 N/m^2. Na dis formula dem dey use calculate am.

kept.q: A stone weighs 8 N in air. When it is fully lowered into a beaker of water, it weighs 5 N. What is the upthrust on the stone?
kept.explanation: Upthrust is the loss in weight when an object is immersed in a liquid, so Upthrust = Weight in air - Weight in water = 8 N - 5 N = 3 N.
kept.pidgin: Upthrust na di weight wey di stone lose for water, so Upthrust = Weight for air - Weight for water = 8N - 5N = 3N.

kept.q: A metal object of volume 200 cm^3 is completely submerged in a liquid of density 1.25 g/cm^3. Taking g = 10 m/s^2, calculate the upthrust on the object.
kept.explanation: Mass of liquid displaced = density x volume = 1.25 g/cm^3 x 200 cm^3 = 250 g = 0.25 kg. By Archimedes' principle, Upthrust = mg = 0.25 kg x 10 m/s^2 = 2.5 N.
kept.pidgin: Mass of liquid wey e push comot = density x volume = 1.25 x 200 = 250 g = 0.25 kg. Upthrust = mg = 0.25 x 10 = 2.5 N, na so Archimedes principle take work.

kept.q: A block of plastic floats on water with 3/5 of its volume submerged. If the density of water is 1000 kg/m^3, what is the density of the plastic block?
kept.explanation: For a floating body, the fraction submerged equals the ratio of the body's density to the liquid's density: fraction = density of object / density of liquid. So density of plastic = (3/5) x 1000 = 600 kg/m^3.
kept.pidgin: For floating object, di fraction wey dey inside liquid = density of object / density of liquid. So density of di plastic = (3/5) x 1000 = 600 kg/m^3.

kept.q: Which law in Physics states that a floating body displaces a weight of fluid exactly equal to its own weight?
kept.explanation: The law of flotation states that a floating object displaces its own weight of the fluid in which it floats, which is why ships made of steel can float even though steel itself is denser than water.
kept.pidgin: Law of flotation talk say any floating object go push comot liquid wey weight equal to im own weight, na why big steel ship fit float for water sef.
